messages:
emma (support): FYI Acme reported a sudden spike in 503s from hosted embeddings this morning, started ~08:12 UTC. They send large batched requests (batch_size=1024) and see the gateway return 503s intermittently. Customer says SDK retried and hit them with bursts.

nate (support): Can you paste the sample request they used and any response snippets? Do we have proxy/gateway logs for that tenant?

emma (support): Customer repro snippet (from them):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"model":"embed-xl","inputs":[...1024 items...]}'
```
They said retries are default SDK (3 tries, no jitter). Response example: `HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable` with body `{"error":"gateway overloaded"}`. I attached their request id but sharing here: req=acme-req-20260317-01.

support-bot: ALERT: queue_length.gateway=1980 (threshold 1000) for region-usw2 at 08:14:12 UTC; spike correlates with acme tenant ingress.

raj (eng-runtime): Thanks. Early hypothesis: huge batch -> long per-request processing + persistent SDK retries -> queue buildup -> gateway backpressure -> 503s. Need p95 server latency for embed model and worker queue metrics for the tenant. Also check auth handshake times (we've seen long TLS renegotiation amplify queueing).

tilly (oncall): Temporary mitigation: can we apply a per-tenant concurrency limiter (max_inflight=8) and reduce max_batch_size to 256 for acme? Also flip streaming_off for embeddings for that tenant. I can push a quick rule to rate-limiter.

nate (support): I asked Acme to hold new test runs. Applying limiter now. Also asked them to enable SDK exponential jitter and cap concurrency client-side. Suggested config: `maxRetries=2, baseBackoffMs=200, jitter=true`.

emma (support): Limiter + smaller batch policy applied for tenant `acme-corp` at 08:16:35 UTC. Customer re-ran their workload at 08:20 and reported errors dropped dramatically.

raj (eng-runtime): Good. Please collect traces for req=acme-req-20260317-01 and any new failure IDs. I'll check kernel selection logs and auth latencies; if TLS renegotiation shows up, we'll add persistent connections fix for that path.

nate (support): Got traces and short log excerpt from gateway: `WARN gateway: enqueue_time_ms=1523, worker_wait_ms=980, downstream_error=503, tenant=acme-corp`. Sending to you in DM, raj.

raj (eng-runtime): Received. Plan: (1) postmortem on queueing + SDK retry amplification, (2) add tenant-level throttles to default policy, (3) tweak client SDK docs to default to jittered backoff for large batches. Will follow up with timeline. :thumbsup:

tilly (oncall): Customer updated: "errors almost gone after limiting". I'll keep monitoring for 1 hour then de-escalate.

emma (support): Thanks all — I'll update Acme and close this ticket once we have RCA notes.
